verdict.rationale: BigQuery's release notes say pipelines can be created, stored, and managed in Git folders. Dataform, the companion transformation service, is documented to version-control and schedule BigQuery workflows and supports collaboration through Git, so versioning is covered and review is implied. Missing for 10: explicit rollback/revert of automations, a documented review/approval flow (e.g. pull requests), version control for other automation types such as scheduled queries and continuous queries, and independent hands-on corroboration.
